sentences.l2: ゆいさんは、家の庭に小さなプレイハウスを作ります。
sentences.l1: Yui is making a small playhouse in the garden of her house.

sentences.l2: まず、紙に設計図をかいて、まどのデザインを考えました。
sentences.l1: First, she drew a blueprint on paper and thought about the design of the windows.

sentences.l2: お父さんといっしょに、木で作ります。
sentences.l1: She will make it out of wood together with her father.

sentences.l2: 友だちとあそびたいからです。
sentences.l1: It is because she wants to play with her friends.
